what: These are the bytes v0.5.8 uploaded to its GitHub release page, copied here on 2026-11-28 so a reader can check the page against something that is not the page. The release is still a draft, so the page is not public; the assets are read through the release asset API by an authenticated caller in the same repository. anchors/pins/uibc-release-v0.5.8.json is the repository form of the pin the page does not yet carry.

signature.verified_here: Ed25519 verify passed locally against the public_key_b64 the signature file carries (2026-11-28, cryptography 50.0.2); the same key_id and public key as v0.5.5

tsa.detail: anchor_freetsa.tsr is in this directory (4,643 bytes, sha256 271ec1df35a0b0c071a152789acaea4e81670c8455ed4eaf42df9cb0848e2a54); verify with tools/check_release_anchors.py, which needs the network

ots.detail: CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt.ots as the page serves it (915 bytes, sha256 5a8a0a73e29f514bfed545f80f579e09cc1d61683c42953bd8d5fa4b8f043f66)

limits: A signature says which key signed these bytes, not who controls that key outside this repository. The timestamp states what the token says; neither proves who published the page or that the workflow behaved. The release being a draft means the page cannot be cited as public evidence.
